notes.subject: moya wa bophelo bja ka
notes.rationale: נפשׁ ke 'selo se se hemago — mafura a bophelo' — e sego 'moya wa ka' fela; phetolelo e okeditše bophelo go tlhatlhoba sebopego sa lentšu

notes.subject: a se ke ka tšhaba
notes.rationale: אבוש e bolela 'go swarwa ke mašwabi' — 'a se ke ka swarwa ke mašwabi' e ka ba poletšo ya bobedi; 'go tšhaba' e tliša lentsu la Kgowedi

notes.subject: go Yahwe
notes.rationale: Thapelo ye e tswalwa le go 18–19, go lebana le Yahwe ka bobedi

translation: Hlokomela moya wa bophelo bja ka, gomme o ntlotle; a se ke ka tšhaba, ka gobane ke itšhereletše go wena.
